title: FastText
seoDescription: Learn FastText-style word representations from tokenized documents and compose embeddings from character n-grams.
description:
Extract character n-grams bounded by boundary angle brackets for subword representation.

By representing each word as the sum of its character n-gram embeddings, FastText generates meaningful representations for rare or unseen inflected words.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\mathcal{G}_w = \{ \text{subword} \in \text{n-grams}(<w>, n \in [n_{\min}, n_{\max}]) \} \cup \{ <w> \}
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Surround target word with start and end angle brackets '<' and '>'
2. Extract all contiguous substrings of lengths ranging from min_n to max_n inclusive
3. Include special whole-word token '<word>' and return sorted unique subwords

### Returns
List of unique character n-gram strings sorted lexicographically.
